units: pixels (x right, y down, origin top-left) and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.evidence: phase correlation of furniture region (x1250-1720, y280-860) vs frame 0 at frames 10,20,30,40,49: |shift| <= 0.01 px

perspective.back_wall_floor_line: y = -0.07531*x + 909.21 (fit x 620-1260, max resid 0.9 px); rises to the right -> back wall recedes to the right
perspective.cat_ground_contact_line: lowest mask row vs torso x: y = -0.0974*x + 1003.3 (slightly steeper than the wall line)
perspective.horizon_y_estimate_px: about 590-620 (intersection of cat path line with back-wall line at (4258, 588) if the cat walks parallel to the wall; 611 from sqrt(mask area) vs contact-row fit). Weak; another estimate from torso length gives 742. Treat as +-60 px.
perspective.focal_length: unknown - estimate from a question's depth_info

objects.name: cat
objects.description: black domestic cat with white paws and a plain grey (untextured-looking) head, tail raised in a curve; the only moving object
objects.motion: walks continuously to the right (image +x) and slightly away from the camera (rises in image, shrinks) for the whole clip; no start/stop inside the clip
objects.reference_point: torso_cx/torso_cy (centroid of the dark torso after removing legs, tail, head) is the best proxy for the rig root/pelvis-body centre; mask_cx/mask_cy and bbox centre also given
objects.apparent_size_change: shrinks steadily: torso length 262->176 px (x0.67), sqrt(mask area) 189->138 (x0.73), bbox height 273->202 (x0.74) from frame 0 to 49 -> depth grows roughly 1.35-1.5x
objects.occlusion: none; at frames ~45-49 its head overlaps the table's left leg/shelf in the image but the cat is in front

objects.name: side_table
objects.description: reddish-brown wooden side table with splayed legs and a lower shelf, right of centre against the back wall
objects.legs_bottom_y_px: front-left leg foot ~ (1410, 839); back-right leg foot ~ (1630, 822)

objects.name: table_lamp
objects.description: lamp on the left of the table top: white pleated conical shade, dark brown tapered wooden base

objects.name: mirror

objects.note: manual read from zoomed grid, +-4 px; lower part hidden behind the table

objects.note: manual, +-4 px. A second, smaller-looking vase at x~1438-1478, y~535-653 is its reflection in the mirror, not a separate object

objects.name: right_wall
